raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misdelegated the task to FileSurfer to “locate and download” the March 2021 and July 2020 PDFs, which led FileSurfer to generate an invalid file path (“/workspace/http:/export.arxiv.org/pdf/2007.xx”) and repeated 404s instead of extracting the needed time spans. This orchestration error stalled progress and culminated in the arbitrary, incorrect final answer (“31”) rather than the correct 0.2 seconds.
